title: People's Legal Knowledge Observatory (PLKO) — Safe Mode Pilot Metadata & Synthetic Fixtures
subtitle: Authoritative Indonesian legal source register, 12 JSON schemas, and synthetic test fixtures (SAFE MODE)
description: Independent public-interest research dataset under the MA Open Justice & Public Prosperity Initiative 2027-2030. Contains verified Indonesian legal source metadata (Dataset 01) and synthetic test fixtures (Datasets 01-12). Unreviewed plain-language drafts are excluded pending human legal review.
